description: This file defines the MyTimesheetActionRule class, which is a validation rule for timesheet actions within the OrangeHRM time management plugin. It extends an abstract validator class and checks if an input is a valid timesheet action based on a predefined map.

classes.name: MyTimesheetActionRule
classes.description: A validation rule class for verifying timesheet actions.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Checks if the provided input is a valid timesheet action based on the TIMESHEET_ACTION_MAP.
